entities.summary: Joseph Manuel Montoya was an American politician and member of the Democratic Party who served as the 14th and 16th lieutenant governor of New Mexico, in the U.S. House of Representatives (1957–1964) and as a U.S. senator from New Mexico (1964–1977).
